plot_error_curves_plotly: plot training and test error curves from log files using plotly and save to an HTML file
plot_error_curves_pyplot: plot training and test error curves from log files using matplotlib and save to a file
prepare_plot_data: load training log files and extract epoch and metric data for plotting error curves
get_plot_colors: generate a list of distinct colors for plotting multiple series in pyplot or plotly format
refactor_plot_error_curves: refactor the plot_error_curves_plotly function to support a custom metric name and additional log files
